title: Early Intervention for Developmental Delay
brief_summary: This study aims to investigate the effectiveness of early intervention program in Department of Children and Adolescent Psychiatry, Kaohsiung Chang Gung Memorial Hospital. The investigators assume that the frequency of early-intervention and degree of family involvement will be associate with the treatment outcome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children with Developmental Delay
* The caregivers are able to participate in the treatment program

Exclusion Criteria:

* Autism
* Cerebral palsy
